name: kilo-mms
description: Staged delivery loop for Kilo: clarify, chart, build, prove, converge, land-learn, routed by deliver, with planner/researcher/implementor/reviewer/approver/advisor subagents.

notes.excluded: .kilo/workshop, .kilo/plans and .kilo/run are development-only or runtime state and are never installed.
notes.config: .kilo/kilo.json pins planner/advisor to paid kilo-auto/frontier; requires Kilo Gateway access and credits in the target account. Remove the model keys to inherit parent models instead.
